title: Joplin, Missouri, Tornado — May 22, 2011 (Service Assessment)
summary: NWS Central Region Service Assessment of the EF-5 tornado that killed 158 people in Joplin: the warnings, the timeline, and why most residents waited for more confirmation before taking cover.

title: Tropical Cyclone Report: Hurricane Katrina (updated)
summary: NHC's report on Hurricane Katrina: track, intensity, storm surge, the New Orleans levee failures, and the revised toll of nearly 1,400 direct and indirect deaths.

title: Tropical Cyclone Report: Hurricane Harvey
summary: NHC's report on Hurricane Harvey: the Category 4 landfall near Rockport and the most significant tropical cyclone rainfall event in U.S. history, peaking at 60.58 inches near Nederland, Texas.

title: A Case Study of the Camp Fire — Notification, Evacuation, Traffic, and Temporary Refuge Areas (NETTRA) (NIST TN 2252)
summary: NIST case study of how people were warned, evacuated, moved through traffic and sheltered in temporary refuge areas during the 2018 Camp Fire in Concow, Paradise and Magalia — a fire that covered 153,336 acres, destroyed 18,804 structures and killed 85 civilians.
